name: Daily Kakuro
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Kakuro is a puzzle game with numbers. If you have never played Kakuro, it is similar to crosswords but uses numbers instead of letters. The white numbers on the sides serve as hints. The rows and columns must add up to those numbers. This online game comes in 4 modes: easy, medium, hard, and expert. You can play four different games daily by selecting different modes. You can also print out the puzzle and do it by hand to take a break from your screen. Tune in every day for a new puzzle. Click on the calendar if you want to play past puzzles or get ahead on tomorrow’s puzzle.
